definitions.explanation: Expressing confidence that something is true or will happen.
Used when recalling something but not being 100% certain. Often at the beginning of a sentence.

examples.japanese: {確|たし}か{明日|あした}は{日曜日|にちようび}です。
examples.english: If I remember correctly, tomorrow is Sunday.

examples.japanese: {確|たし}か{彼女|かのじょ}は{大阪|おおさか}から{来|き}ました。
examples.english: I believe she came from Osaka.

notes: {確|たし}かに (with に) emphasizes certainty more strongly. Without に, it often expresses uncertain recall. Also used as a na-adjective meaning 'certain/reliable': {確|たし}かな{情報|じょうほう} (reliable information).
